title: A creator who offers only surface action narrows the reach to audiences who share the story's context and era
body:
- Depth elements are the substance that lets a story reach across cultural boundaries, so their absence leaves the work with only surface action to carry the connection.
- Surface action requires the original context to be intelligible, so the work's ability to connect with diverse audiences is reduced.
- The same gap also compromises timeless authenticity by cutting the story off from truths that endure beyond its era.
conversion: Surface action meant to enable universal reach narrows the reach to audiences who share the work's context and era.
